description: STUB: session_ledger_service::get_import_status — implementation deferred post-AWS-solet per coordinator_plan.md P2. Stub JSON allows the process registry to start; the method is registered but the service is not wired.
embedding_description: Read the import batch row for a given batch_id from the LLM session ledger. Returns the repository row dict or raises LedgerRepositoryError("no import batch with id ...") when batch_id is unknown. Row fields: id, source_id, started_at, finished_at, status, event_count, error_message, error_kind. Used after trigger_poll (or shipper-driven ingest) to inspect a specific batch's outcome.
